readback: Each spend transaction earns points based on its amount. A transaction of $200 or more earns 3x the amount in points, and a transaction under $200 earns 1x. Each member can earn at most 2,000 bonus points from this offer over their lifetime.
assumptions: 'Spends' is taken as the Spend activity type (SPEND). It could also mean Shopping (PURCHASE).
The spend amount is read from BIT Amount (h_bit_amount), and the threshold is applied to each transaction on its own, not to cumulative spend.
'3x points' means points = amount x 3 in total, not 3x on top of base earning. 1x means points = amount x 1.
The 2,000-point lifetime cap applies to all points this offer awards, in both bands.
No start or end dates were given, so the offer has none. Points go to the DELTA MILES account.
